demo.title: Executable fragment runs: Hill-climbing optimizer fragment
demo.code:
function hillClimb(f,x0,step,iters){if(iters>100000)return {refused:true,reason:'iteration budget exceeded'};var x=x0,fx=f(x);for(var i=0;i<iters;i++){var c=x+step,fc=f(c);if(fc>fx){x=c;fx=fc;}else step*=-0.5;}return {x:+x.toFixed(4),f:+fx.toFixed(4)};}
var r=hillClimb(function(x){return -(x-3)*(x-3)+9;},0,1,200);J(r);assert(Math.abs(r.x-3)<0.01&&Math.abs(r.f-9)<0.01,'opt');
